conceptZh: 發條樂團的小豬鼓太大，大鼓小號的比例逗趣，最後胖嘟嘟一起搖。
object: a wind-up animal band: a chubby piglet on a tiny drum, a skinny rooster on a huge tuba
morph: size-mismatched instruments are swapped and strokes bounce out forming 胖
creativeAngle: 小豬坐上迷你鼓，大喇叭對公雞太大，換來換去，最後肚子彈出筆畫。
promptEn:
An 8-second animated clip on a pale baby-blue backdrop with a thin floor line. Lead: a wind-up toy band, a round pink piglet with a visible turning key, and a skinny rooster. The finished glyph 胖 is a saturated coral-pink, centered, about 70% of frame height.
0.0-1.7s: the piglet tries to sit on a tiny drum stool and squishes it flat; the drum goes boing. First "胖" as the rooster comically drops his huge tuba on his own head.
1.7-3.3s: size mismatch: they swap, the piglet's belly fills the huge tuba's bell, and the rooster disappears in the little drum. Second "胖" lands as the piglet's belly pops out of the bell with a wobble.
3.3-5.0s: the belly bounces strokes upward, which land into the glyph 胖 with a jiggly thump; the rooster peeks out of the drum.
5.0-8.0s: HOLD, glyph perfectly still. At "胖嘟嘟" the piglet jiggles a round belly dance, the rooster spins his key, little musical notes puff out, and the piglet gives a happy wobbling bow beside the glyph.
Audio: Off-screen voice, warm and friendly, clear Taiwanese Mandarin, slow and distinct, reading exactly "胖、胖、胖嘟嘟" (ㄆㄤˋ、ㄆㄤˋ、ㄆㄤˋ ㄉㄨ ㄉㄨ) with clear tones: the character, a short pause, the character again, then the word once, and nothing after it. No subtitles or vocabulary text; the only text on screen is the single glyph 胖.
No other text, no watermark, no flashing, no real people.

conceptZh: 圓滾滾的大怪獸想吃高架上的大布丁，一跳撲空卻用肚子彈了起來，像皮球一樣在地板、牆壁、天花板和發條鯊魚頭上連環亂彈，每撞一下就「喀」地敲進一筆，最後一彈坐上拼好的「胖」字頂端再滾下來，挺著圓肚子抱住布丁。
object: a huge round fuzzy lilac monster with one horn, so round it bounces like a rubber ball, chasing a giant wobbly pudding on a high shelf
morph: each ricochet knocks strokes into place: left-wall bonks clack in the 月 side, the shark-head and right-wall bonks clack in the 半 side; the final ceiling bounce drops the monster on top of the finished 胖 before it rolls off to the side
creativeAngle: 跟前一版「小豬樂團、肚子搖一搖」完全不同：這次把「胖」的意思變成物理笑點，大怪獸因為太圓而像皮球一樣彈跳，用彈跳連鎖把筆畫一筆一筆敲進去，發條鯊魚只負責被當成彈跳板、咬錯東西後原地轉圈。最後唸「胖胖」時怪獸鼓起圓肚子抱布丁，聲音與畫面同步。
promptEn:
An 8-second 2D cartoon clip on a soft pale-mint backdrop with a thin floor line, a plain left wall edge, right wall edge and ceiling line so bounces read clearly. Lead: a huge round fuzzy lilac monster with one stubby horn and a goofy grin, so round that it bounces like a rubber ball. Buddy: a chunky teal wind-up toy shark with a turning key that chomps at everything. Goal prop: a giant wobbly caramel pudding on a high shelf at upper right. The target glyph 胖 forms centered in solid tangerine-orange strokes, about 70% of frame height, with clear margins.

0.0-1.5s: the monster stares up at the pudding, pats its big round belly, licks its lips, and winds up a huge crouching jump while the shark waddles in from the left snapping at the air.
1.5-3.0s: it jumps, misses the shelf completely, and belly-flops onto the floor. First "胖" lands exactly on that flop. The belly squashes flat, then BOINGS the monster straight back up: the bounce chain begins. It ricochets off the left wall, CLACK, and the first strokes of the left 月 part appear in place.
3.0-5.0s: faster and sillier: ceiling bonk, then it drops onto the shark's head, BONK, the shark chomps at it, bites its own tail instead, and spins in a dizzy circle on the floor. Each bonk clacks more strokes into place, the right-wall hits building the 半 side. Second "胖" is spoken as the biggest ceiling bounce slams the last stroke in and 胖 stands complete, centered and still. The monster plops down sitting proudly on top of the glyph for a beat, teeters, and slides off to the right onto the floor with a soft fuzzy thump, leaving the glyph fully uncovered.
5.0-8.0s: HOLD, 胖 perfectly still and readable. The shelf wobbles from all the bouncing and the pudding slides off, landing in the monster's arms at the lower right. On "胖胖" the monster puffs its belly up extra round and big, hugs the jiggling pudding, and gives a happy bounce in place; the dizzy shark falls over beside it with a grin. Nothing touches the strokes.

Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin reads exactly "胖、胖、胖胖" (ㄆㄤˋ、ㄆㄤˋ、ㄆㄤˋ ㄆㄤˋ), slowly and distinctly with clear tones: the character, a short pause, the character again, then the word once, and nothing after it. Soft cartoon boing and clack sounds quieter than the voice. No subtitles or vocabulary text; the only text on screen is the single glyph 胖. No other text, no watermark, no flashing, no real people, no robots.
